settings.text: Fire engineering that works on site, not just on paper.
Fire engineering and fire safety consultants with a construction background — proportionate, defensible, buildable advice across the whole life of your building.

Fire advice may look right in a report, only to unravel when design decisions meet the realities of construction. Our advice comes from a construction background, where we have spent our careers working within the built environment. We understand how buildings are designed, built, altered and occupied, so our advice is shaped by what can be delivered in practice. From first concept to occupied building, we deliver fire strategies that are practical, proportionate and buildable — while you work directly with a senior Chartered Engineer from start to finish.
Across the whole life of your building.
Coeus Technical are a fire engineering and safety consultancy. We help building projects stay safe, compliant, and buildable — from initial concept through construction and throughout occupancy.
Feasibility, options appraisal, first fire strategies and Gateway 1 support — worked from the building, not the checklist.
Fire strategy, statements and technical notes that hold up to scrutiny and stay buildable.
Support through construction, resolving the real-world detail as the building goes up.
Risk assessment, FRAEW and safety-case support keeping the building safe in occupation.
"Will this advice actually get the project through planning, the BSR and building control?"
"Can I defend these decisions to residents, members and the regulator?"
"What exactly must I do, and can I rely on this advice?"
"Can I put this expert in front of a judge?"
"Does this fire engineer understand design intent — and will they help me discharge my Principal Designer obligations?"
"Is this building actually safe as it stands, and do I know what I'm responsible for?"
Don't see your role here? We work with anyone involved in the life of a building — get in touch and we'll tell you whether we're the right people.

We know from experience that we are not the lowest-cost fire safety consultancy. Our value statement is quality, dependability and accountability for the advice we provide — and the confidence that brings our clients back to us.
We know whether a strategy can actually be built, so our advice is buildable, not just compliant on paper.
Proportionate and performance-based where it serves the project; never over- or under-engineered.
Every project carries senior, Chartered oversight, and we put our name to the position we give you — clear, defensible and yours to act on with confidence.
From Gateway 2 approvals for high-rise residential schemes to FRAEW assessments that unlock lender funding and expert witness reports for court — a range of the projects we have led.

Fire engineering with integrity.
Let's talk about your building.
Tell us about your project and we will come back to you with a clear view of how we can help — and whether we are the right fit.
